component.name: Dot
component.summary: Navegador web pequeño, rápido y silencioso

description.p: Dot is a native Linux web browser based on Search by Office Commun (MIT), built in Rust with GTK4, libadwaita, and Chromium Embedded Framework in windowless Alloy mode.
Its interface shows only tabs (top bar or vertical sidebar) and the web page: no toolbars, no home page, no accounts, no sync, and no telemetry.

Dot es un navegador web nativo para Linux basado en Search por Office Commun (licencia MIT), desarrollado íntegramente en Rust con GTK4, libadwaita y Chromium Embedded Framework en modo Alloy sin interfaz de Chrome.
La interfaz se limita a las pestañas (arriba o en barra lateral vertical) y la página: sin barras de herramientas, sin página de inicio, sin cuentas, sin sincronización y sin telemetría.

ul.li: Strict privacy by default: third-party cookies blocked, Global Privacy Control (Sec-GPC), click-ID stripping, and zero background Google services.
Built-in Shield ad/tracker blocking, Curtain element hider, Reader Mode, Split View, and Picture-in-Picture.
Local Secret Service password Vault with zero plaintext credentials on disk.
Native Wayland and X11 support with automatic light and dark desktop integration.

developer.name: Dot contributors (Based on Search by Office Commun)

description.p: Initial Linux port with GTK4/libadwaita UI, CEF 156 Alloy OSR engine, tabs and session persistence, history, bookmarks, downloads, privacy protections, bench tooling, and Flatpak packaging.
